Corollary
[ball containment in the chart domain]

Source: petersen:page-0431 ↗ prop:pet-ch11-norm-properties 1. ch11:11.3.3If $\| (M,g,p)\| _{C^{m,\alpha },r}\le Q$, then $B(p,e^{-Q}r)\subset U$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch11-norm-bound-ball-containment \sketch Let $q\in \partial U$ minimize distance to $p$. A minimizing segment from $p$ to $q$ has coordinate radius tending to $r$; the lower distance bound in part (4) of subsection 3.3 therefore gives

\[ |pq|\ge e^{-Q}r. \]

Hence $B(p,e^{-Q}r)\subset U$.

□
